info.title: TIHO Catalog API
info.description: Public read-only lifestyle catalog. Stable UUIDs and slugs, structured attributes, search and composable filters. Prices are RUB. No authentication required.

price.description: Price in RUB, up to two decimal places. Stored as integer kopecks.

get.summary: Worker liveness; does not query the database
Search, filter and paginate the catalog
get.description: Public read-only catalog. Multiple values within a filter are OR; different filters are AND. Price bounds are inclusive RUB. Sorting always includes a stable ID tie-breaker. Pages beyond the last return an empty items array with the correct total.
